quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal 2026 capital expenditures were $418 million (vs $412 million in fiscal 2025), and Western Digital expects fiscal 2027 capital expenditures to be higher than 2026 as it invests in its heads and media operations and in automation to increase productivity. Purchase obligations and other commitments, which include its capital expenditure commitments and long-term supplier agreements with fixed future commitments contingent on the vendor's performance, quality and technology, were $310 million as of July 3, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 capex $418 million; FY2027 capex expected higher; purchase obligations and other commitments $310 million (July 3, 2026)
